sources.excerpt: SBGO Effects · Handmade analog effect pedals · Distortion, Fuzz, Overdrive for Metal Punk Skip to content SBGO EFFECTS · HANDMADE Pedals Workshop Friends Order Contact FR Order NON-PROFIT · W131008965 · HANDMADE IN FRANCE FIG. 001 · HOME / EST. 2010 · PROVENCE EFFETS · GUITARE · BASSE HANDMADE · ANALOG · 9V ● SBGO · MASTER ARTWORK N° W131008965 · LOI 1901 SINCE 2010 · NON-PROFIT Analog effect pedals. Etched, soldered, painted — one at a time. From vintage crunch to a wall of distortion. For guitarists and bassists who want a sound that belongs to them. Seven characters. Every one built by hand at the workshop. Click "Listen · Watch" for audio demos, videos and photos 07 / 07 unités SBGO · 01 SIGNATURE Heavy metal ↻ Listen · Watch · 9 media Dark Pass Anger price 185 € Guitar distortion · hand-painted bloody finish A fully original design, the DPA mixes vintage and modern for a unique grain. Plays every style — rock, hard rock, heavy metal. ▸ Input and output FET buffer ▸ Active tone control centered on mids ▸ From a slight crunch to a loud distortion ▸ 3-position low-pass filter ▸ Hand-painted "Dark Pass Anger" finish Order ↘ Click image for demos SBGO · 01 · DARK PASS ANGER Sounds · Videos · Photos ← Back to the spec SOUNDS Demo 1 — Jackson Kelly + ChaosLand Crunch Heavy metal Palm mute, etc. Demo 2 — Bongo (Lag + Smokey90 Jr) Overdrive Metal 1 Metal 2 Metal 2b Metal 3 Samples: Jackson Kelly + SP Custom ChaosLand + DPA + ENGL Tube Toner. Plus Bongo samples: Lag + Smokey90 Jr SP Custom + DPA + H K simulation. PHOTOS ← Back to the spec SBGO · 02 Stoner / Death ↻ Listen · Watch · 2 media Dark Bass Anger price 185 € High-gain bass distortion · the little sister Developed with bass players, the DBA delivers a powerful distortion that respects the attack of the instrument. Also great on guitar for stoner and old-school death metal tones. ▸ Input and output FET buffer ▸ Active mid notch filter ▸ From boost to heavy saturation ▸ "Dry Pot" option: independent clean control ▸ Killer look — like its sister Order ↘ Click image for demos SBGO · 02 · DARK BASS ANGER Sounds · Videos · Photos ← Back to the spec SOUNDS Demo — Igor Lallai Rhythm Demo: Igor Lallai. Big up! VIDEOS ▶ DEMO · 01 PHOTOS ← Back to the spec SBGO · 03 MORE/RISK Fuzz wall ↻ Listen · Watch · 1 media Fat’n Dirty price 220 € Big-Muff–style distortion · on steroids The 3 standard knobs plus a MORE footswitch that adds a second gain stage. No more compromise — extreme compressed tone. ⚠ Use at your own risk for your sound. ▸ Volume — overall level ▸ Tone — high-cut or low-cut ▸ Gain — from a slight crunch to ultra-compressed ▸ MORE footswitch — extra amp stage Order ↘ Click image for demos SBGO · 03 · FAT’N DIRTY Sounds · Videos · Photos ← Back to the spec PHOTOS ← Back to the spec SBGO · 04 Overdrive ↻ Listen · Watch · 4 media Black Widow price 185 € Tri-mode overdrive · vintage, modern, boost Inspired by a well-known green overdrive — picks up the standards but adds its own character. Original op-amp, 2 clipping modes, plus a boost mode to push your amp. ▸ Original op-amp for a stronger base ▸ 2 clipping modes: vintage tube-like or modern ▸ Boost mode (clipping bypass) ▸ "Modern Style" finish Order ↘ Click image for demos SBGO ·
